title: SongForge Pipeline
description: Issue #18 AC2: live pipeline view -- jobs by state, generation-semaphore utilization, and failure/refund rates.

panels.title: Jobs by state
panels.description: songforge_jobs_in_state{state} -- point-in-time job counts per pipeline state (QUEUED, SUBMITTING, WAITING_FOR_WEBHOOK, INGEST_PENDING, READY, FAILED), scraped from Postgres by the PipelineCollector at every /metrics scrape.

panels.title: Generation-slot utilization
panels.description: songforge_generation_slots_in_use{scope} against songforge_generation_slots_capacity{scope="global"} -- how full the global generation semaphore is (only "global" has a meaningful capacity; "per_user_total" is a sum across however many users currently hold a slot).

panels.title: Job failure rate
panels.description: rate(songforge_jobs_failed_total[5m]) -- terminal job failures per second.

panels.title: Ingest failure rate
panels.description: rate(songforge_ingest_failed_total[5m]) -- audio-ingest failures per second (R2/webhook path).

panels.title: Quota refund rate
panels.description: rate(songforge_quota_refunded_total[5m]) -- quota refunds issued per second when a job fails after consuming a user's daily-quota slot.
